Copied byte-for-byte. This is an independent exported two-body STEP fixture:
a cube and cylinder with authored placements and a conversion-based metre
representation context. It qualifies curved geometry and length-unit handling;
it does not contain an assembly hierarchy. Authored colors are retained in the
input, but Catwalk's STEP importer currently renders its default surface color.
